simple.meaning: קִיר (qîyr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a wall (as built in a trench ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 74 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Joshua, 1 Samuel, and 11 more, beginning at Exodus 30:3. Its contexts include offering, altar, blood, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קִיר (H7023).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קִיר (qîyr) / H7023 is traced through Exodus 30:3, Exodus 37:26, Leviticus 1:15, Leviticus 5:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.
